effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` WETH to the vault (safeTransferFrom in OZ ERC4626._deposit); the vault supplies it to Morpho Blue markets.
The vault mints svETH shares to `receiver`; the share amount comes from stored totals (_convertToSharesWithTotals, floor), with no minimum.
Before pricing, _accrueInterest mints fee shares to the fee recipient, which is part of the share price.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the exact WETH amount, a constant 'Share ticker: svETH' line, and the shares receiver.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many svETH shares arrive; the contract computes them from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 0: signer receives 412915698960183 svETH; the screen shows only 'Share ticker: svETH'.
findings.fix: No calldata holds the share amount. Wallets could add a preview; the descriptor cannot.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' names neither the asset nor that svETH shares come back.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, no interpolatedIntent; the 'Share ticker' field is a raw constant without an amount.
findings.fix: Change intent to "Deposit WETH for svETH shares" and add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for svETH shares to {receiver}".

cases.notes: WETH out shown exactly. svETH in: asset and receiver shown, amount not shown (storage-derived).

effects: The signer pays WETH to the vault; the amount comes from stored totals (_convertToAssetsWithTotals, ceil), with no maximum in calldata.
The vault mints exactly `shares` svETH to `receiver`.
Before pricing, _accrueInterest mints fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', 'Deposit asset: WETH' with no amount, the exact svETH shares, and the receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much WETH leaves the signer; the contract computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Case 1: signer sends 1018411169 wei WETH; screen shows 'Deposit asset: WETH' only.
findings.fix: No calldata holds the asset amount and the function has no max-assets bound; nothing in the descriptor can show it.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays WETH for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`; the payment shows only as a raw constant field 'Deposit asset' = `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`.
findings.fix: Change intent to "Pay WETH to mint svETH shares" and add interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} for {receiver}, paid in WETH".

cases.notes: WETH out: asset and direction shown, amount absent. Shares go to 0xdEaD, which the screen shows and the reader understood.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns svETH shares from `owner`; the amount comes from stored totals (ceil).
If the caller is not `owner`, the caller's svETH allowance from `owner` is spent.
The vault sends exactly `assets` WETH to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', the exact WETH amount, the receiver and the owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many svETH shares the vault burns; the amount comes from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Case 2: 47029592978704524727 svETH leave the signer; no field shows them.
findings.fix: Nothing in calldata holds the share amount. Consider a label such as 'Burns svETH shares from' for the owner field.

cases.notes: WETH in shown exactly. svETH burn: owner shown, asset and amount not shown.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` svETH from `owner`; if the caller is not `owner`, it spends the caller's allowance.
The vault sends WETH to `receiver`; the amount comes from stored totals (floor), with no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', the exact svETH shares, the receiver and the owner; nothing names the asset that arrives.

findings.title: redeem does not name WETH as the asset received, so the reader guessed ETH or WETH.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format has only fields shares, receiver, owner. The mint format shows `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`; redeem does not. Case 3: signer receives 424881792420229 WETH; reader: 'Underlying asset (likely ETH or WETH)'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for WETH to {receiver}".

findings.title: redeem does not show the WETH amount received; it comes from storage with no minimum.
findings.fix: No calldata holds the amount; the descriptor cannot show it.

cases.notes: svETH out shown exactly. WETH in: neither asset nor amount on screen.
